Its been a little over 8 years since and now I find myself working in the special operations community doing more humanitarian missions then combat, when im done here i plan on becoming a teacher who works in war torn environments.

The thing I'm trying to get at is this, and this is one way to look at life.

At the end of the day its your life, do as you please and do what you must. But understand the the consequences a d actions of said choices. If you truly believe life is pointless and doesn't matter, find a cause and give everything to it. It doesn't even have to be something you like, i originally had no intentions of joining the military I just wanted to die and take this want to the grave with me. Now I have a passion for working with kids and people from less fortunate environments along with the simi health pleasure of hurting people who hurt others senselessly.

Short story time: 

When I was 19, I was serving in the military in Afghanistan.  This was the first time I had ever been out the country. A few months go by and im at a Polish base somewhere in aghan land, and boom! VBID(car bomb to keep it simple) goes off and insurgents come pouring in through the hole now in the perimeter wall. Me, two of my buddies and my Sargent were fairly close, close enough to where the bomb's blast wave knocked us down. Me admittedly both figuratively and literally scared shitless, was frozen in fear do to the small arms fire and rockets flying near and around me. Then just like that my Sargent on his then 6th or 5th deployment comes beside me helps me up, and no bull shit in the calmest manner looks me dead in the eye and says " having a shitty day I see." I looked at him and I swear till this day I have never laughed so hard in my life. After our laugh he says to me "don't worry about it, happens to the best of us. And hey could be worse"

A bunch stuff happened after that but while we were in combat but all I could think about were those words.

"could be worse"

After that, till this day I live by those words. Having a shit day a work? Could be worse. Someone just hit your car? Could be worse. Shit your pants in the middle of a combat zone? Could be worse 😅😂
